articles.title: Why the Ebola Outbreak Keeps Growing, According to Virus Expert Pardis Sabeti
articles.summary: The ongoing Ebola outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is now the second largest on record. The virus has infected more than 11,000 people in five countries and has killed more than 5,700 people as of Nov. 20. articles.title: Thanksgiving Dinner Is Set to Cost Americans More This Year, Says Farm Bureau. Here’s Why
articles.summary: The American Farm Bureau Federation (AFBF) estimates that the cost of Thanksgiving dinner this year will be up more than 6% compared to last year, with steep turkey prices and higher fuel costs driving up the bill. The average 10-person dinner will cost $58.63, compared to $55.18 in 2025, according to the bureau’s annual report . articles.title: Zelensky Says Ukraine Sank Russian Warship at Naval Base in Libya
articles.summary: Ukraine sank a Russian warship moored at a port in Libya using naval drones, said Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky . Forces deployed seven Ukrainian-made drones that struck and sank the Russian corvette Mercury, which was carrying a combat helicopter, Zelensky said Monday morning. A second ship, the Russian container carrier MV ANGARA, which Zelensky said was being used to “transport weapons,” was also hit.
